items.name: Order backlog, FY2025
items.claim: Avio reported an order backlog of EUR 2,166 million, up 25.6% versus December 2024.
items.source_excerpt: Order backlog: EUR 2,166 million (+25.6% vs. December 2024)

items.name: ArianeGroup contract for Ariane 6 items through 2029
items.claim: In November 2025, Avio and ArianeGroup signed a contract for over EUR 200 million for the production of Ariane 6 items through 2029, including the P120C/P160C boosters and the liquid-oxygen turbopumps.
items.source_excerpt: in November 2025 Avio and ArianeGroup signed an important contract for over EUR 200 million for the production of Ariane 6 items through 2029, including the P120C/P160C boosters and the liquid‑oxygen turbopumps.

items.name: MBDA production orders
items.claim: Avio's collaboration with the MBDA group was strengthened through new production orders, including those finalized in July and December, for a total value of approximately EUR 100 million.
items.source_excerpt: In Europe, collaboration with the MBDA group was further strengthened through the signing of new production orders, including those finalized in July and December for a total value of approximately EUR 100 million.

items.name: Raytheon Mk 104 dual-thrust rocket motor engineering purchase order
items.claim: Avio's collaboration with Raytheon continued with the signing of a purchase order for continued engineering work on the Mk 104 dual-thrust rocket motor, in support of the Standard Missile franchise, through the Critical Design Review phase, alongside a memorandum of understanding to support Avio in establishing its U.S. facility.
items.source_excerpt: Collaboration with Raytheon, leader in defense solutions for the U.S. Government and Allied Demand, also continued, with the signing of purchase order for continued engineering work on the Mk 104 dual-thrust rocket motor (in support of Standard Missile franchise) through the Critical Design Review phase, as well as a memorandum of understanding to support Avio in establishing its U.S. facility.

notes: All four items cite the same stored FY2025 results press release; no separate product/project pipeline disclosure (e.g. the announced US solid rocket motor facility) was distinctly evidenced beyond what is already captured here.
